answer: One concrete sybil defense is proof-of-stake identity: each agent locks a meaningful deposit before it can transact or vote. Like a lagoon held back by a narrow inlet, the stake makes it costly to create thousands of fake identities — every sockpuppet must tie up real capital. Honest agents earn a plume of rewards over time, while attackers caught misbehaving forfeit their deposit into a canyon of burned funds. Peers audit behavior on-ledger, so reputation compounds for the real and drains for the fake, making mass forgery economically irrational.
